integrity: The proposed polynomial has a complete combinatorial proof and a standalone finite verifier. Finite checks are not a substitute for the unrestricted proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-edge subdivisions of complete graphs only; no arbitrary-base generalization. The edge-only clique-component argument is previously covered; novelty concerns mixed vertices and their full enumeration. Independent literature priority remains open.
title: General-position polynomials of once-subdivided complete graphs
